title: Open Mic @ Nirvana Soul Coffee
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring music poetry and comedy. Performers of all skill levels welcome in this supportive community atmosphere. Free to attend with a vibrant creative vibe.
event_venue_information:
About Nirvana Soul Coffee

Nirvana Soul Coffee is a vibrant community-centered coffee shop in downtown San Jose founded by sisters Jeronica Macey and Be'Anka Ashaolu. Opened during the COVID-19 pandemic as one of the city's first Black women-owned cafés this welcoming space serves specialty lattes gourmet pastries and thoughtfully sourced locally roasted coffee.

Music and Events

The venue hosts Nirvana Soul After Dark open mic nights every Friday from 6-9 PM welcoming musicians poets and comedians of all experience levels. The cafe also features rotating local artwork small business pop-ups and community events creating a joyful creative atmosphere. Whether you're meeting friends working on a laptop or enjoying live performances this is a place where community and creativity thrive.

Atmosphere

With a cozy second-floor loft area perfect for hanging out excellent wifi and even a piano available for use with permission Nirvana Soul offers ample space for connection and creation. The venue celebrates inclusivity and accessibility making everyone feel welcome in this colorful downtown gathering place.

title: Acoustic Open Mic @ Bogey's Pizza
event_description: Friendly acoustic instrument open mic featuring local musicians from newbies to professionals. Backup musicians available. Each performer gets 2 songs or 10 minutes. Great family-friendly atmosphere with full bar.
backline: PA System with two mics and two line inputs. Keyboards welcome.
event_venue_information:
About Bogey's Pizza Co.

Bogey's Pizza has been a beloved family-friendly restaurant in San Jose for over 25 years serving delicious pizza with a special spice blend that keeps customers coming back. The venue features a full bar great family dining and an open welcoming atmosphere perfect for celebrations and casual gatherings.

South Bay Folks Open Mic

Every Friday from 6-9 PM the South Bay Folks run a highly regarded acoustic instrument open mic. Sign ups start at 5:45 PM and the event features a super friendly mix of local musicians ranging from complete beginners to seasoned professionals. The welcoming environment includes backup musicians who are always available to support performers making this one of the most encouraging open mics in the Bay Area.

Venue Details

The restaurant offers an open bright family-friendly space that's perfect for events from birthdays to celebrations. With ample seating a salad bar and a relaxed sports-on-TV atmosphere Bogey's creates the ideal setting for both performers and audiences to enjoy an evening of acoustic music pizza and community.

title: Blues Jam @ Poor House Bistro
event_description: Weekly blues jam session with rotating hosts and seasoned regulars. New Orleans-style venue with live music patio. Free admission - just come ready to play. Great atmosphere for blues musicians and fans.
venue_address: 317 W St John St San Jose CA 95110
event_venue_information:
About Poor House Bistro

Poor House Bistro brings the sights sounds and tastes of New Orleans to San Jose. This unique venue is housed in a historic Victorian home that was moved to its current location in San Jose's Little Italy district. Opened in 2005 Poor House has become a staple in the local music scene known for its funky atmosphere legendary po'boys and commitment to live blues music.

Music at Poor House

The venue features live music Wednesday through Sunday with a blues jam on Wednesdays the PHB Famiglia Band on Thursdays and rotating blues acts on weekends. Sunday brunches feature jazz artists while afternoon sets can include blues rock reggae or country - always free. The outdoor patio provides an intimate setting for performances making it a favorite gathering spot for blues fans and musicians. Poor House also hosts a stage at the annual San Jose Fountain Blues & Brews Festival.

Food and Atmosphere

The menu celebrates New Orleans cuisine with blackened chicken wings seafood gumbo BBQ shrimp crawfish pasta jambalaya po'boys and more. With warm hospitality and a welcoming vibe Poor House Bistro offers authentic Crescent City culture right in downtown San Jose near the SAP Center and Caltrain station.

title: Blues Jam @ Narrative Fermentations
event_description: Sunday afternoon blues jam featuring house band with some of the SF Bay Area's best blues musicians. Bring your instrument and sign up to play. Full backline provided including drums bass guitar and harmonica.
venue_address: 101 E Alma Ave San Jose CA 95112
backline: Drums bass guitar harmonica and vocal mics provided
event_venue_information:
About Narrative Fermentations

Narrative Fermentations is a creative story-driven craft brewery located near downtown San Jose specializing in a diverse range of beer styles from crisp lagers and West Coast IPAs to experimental fruited sours and dark beers. The brewery features a laid-back taproom rotating food trucks and a charming outdoor patio with picnic tables.

Live Music and Events

The brewery hosts a weekly Sunday blues jam from 4-7 PM featuring house band members who are among the Bay Area's finest blues musicians. Hosted by San Jose's own Aki Kumar known as the King of Bollywood Blues the jam welcomes blues musicians and singers to sign up and perform. The venue provides full backline including drums bass guitar harmonica and vocal mics making it easy for musicians to just bring their instruments and join in.

Atmosphere

With both indoor seating near the bar and outdoor seating among large picnic tables Narrative offers a relaxed community-focused environment. The brewery regularly features live music community events and a constantly rotating selection of creative craft beers making it an ideal spot to enjoy great music and beverages in a welcoming setting.

title: Blues Jam @ Fuego Sports Bar & Club
event_description: Long-running South Bay blues jam hosted by Dennis Dove and the Dove crew. Pro-level musicians with Johnny Cat and Mike Phillips as regular hosts. One of the area's most established blues sessions.
hosts: Dennis Dove Johnny Cat Mike Phillips
event_venue_information:
About Fuego Sports Bar & Club

Fuego Sports Bar & Club in Sunnyvale is a lively venue that has become the current home for one of the South Bay's most respected blues jam sessions. The venue offers a full bar sports viewing and a welcoming atmosphere for both musicians and music fans.

The Monday Blues Jam

Every Monday from 8-11 PM the venue hosts a pro-level blues jam led by Dennis Dove and his long-running crew. Johnny Cat and Mike Phillips serve as regular hosts bringing their expertise and welcoming spirit to each session. This is one of the most established blues jams in the area having been a fixture in the South Bay music scene for years attracting skilled musicians and creating memorable musical moments week after week.

Music Scene

The jam welcomes blues musicians who are ready to play at a professional level. With full backline provided players can show up with their instruments and join in the rotation. The session has a loyal following of both performers and listeners who appreciate authentic blues played with skill and passion in a supportive environment.

title: Blues Jam @ Little Lou's BBQ
event_description: Weekly blues session at this Campbell BBQ spot. Well-established jam that moved from another venue. Check calendar as jams may be pre-empted by sports broadcasts. Great food and blues atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Little Lou's BBQ

Little Lou's BBQ in Campbell serves delicious BBQ and has become a valued home for live blues music in the South Bay. The restaurant offers a welcoming atmosphere where great food and authentic blues come together creating a perfect evening out.

Thursday Blues Jam

The Thursday blues jam from 6-9 PM is a well-established session that relocated to Little Lou's from another venue bringing its tradition and community of musicians with it. With rotating hosts and full backline provided the jam welcomes blues musicians ready to play. Note that sessions may occasionally be pre-empted by major sports broadcasts so checking the venue's calendar before heading out is recommended.

Venue Experience

The combination of quality BBQ and live blues makes Little Lou's a great destination for both food and music lovers. The laid-back atmosphere supports both performers and audiences creating an authentic blues experience in the heart of Campbell.

title: Rockin' n Blues Jam @ Woodhams Sports Lounge
event_description: First Friday blues and rock jam session. One of South Bay's longest-running venues for blues with gritty good-time atmosphere. Sign-ups at 8:30 PM music starts at 9 PM. Raw real and full of heart.
venue_address: 4475 Stevens Creek Blvd Santa Clara CA 95051
event_venue_information:
About Woodhams Sports Lounge

Woodhams Sports Lounge is a vibrant dive bar and community hub in Santa Clara known for its welcoming inclusive atmosphere and diverse entertainment offerings. Run by owner Amanda the venue has become a beloved local spot where everyone feels like family regardless of background or experience level.

Music and Entertainment

The lounge offers something every night of the week. Mondays feature open mic jam nights with Jimmy Tone. First Fridays host the Rockin' n Blues Jam with Bob Gonzalez starting at 9 PM after 8:30 PM sign-ups - a gritty authentic jam that's been running for years. Other Fridays feature live bands including Honey Wilders Band and Vinyl Council Night. The venue also hosts karaoke multiple nights weekly and themed DJ nights.

Atmosphere

The space embraces its quirky dive bar character with eclectic decor wheelchair accessibility and a no-frills approach that focuses on quality drinks great music and genuine community. Whether you're coming for blues rock karaoke or just to watch sports on the many TVs Woodhams provides a safe welcoming space where regulars and newcomers alike can relax laugh and connect over shared love of music and good times.

title: Open Mic @ First Unitarian Church
event_description: Second Saturday monthly open mic featuring music and spoken word in a beautiful sanctuary with great acoustics. Games available in social hall. Sign ups at 6:00 PM performer drawing at 6:20 PM. Free event.
venue_name: First Unitarian Church of San Jose
event_venue_information:
About First Unitarian Church of San Jose

First Unitarian Church of San Jose offers a beautiful sanctuary space with exceptional acoustics making it an ideal venue for musical and spoken word performances. The church welcomes the community for various events including their monthly open mic and game night.

Open Mic and Game Night

Held on the second Saturday of each month from 6-9:30 PM this unique event combines music and entertainment in two spaces. The sanctuary hosts open mic sign-ups starting at 6 PM with a performer drawing at 6:20 PM. Musicians and spoken word artists perform in the beautiful acoustically-rich sanctuary while the social hall offers games including cards and board games - guests are welcome to bring their own games as well.

Community Spirit

The event is free though donations are welcome to support use of the church space. Limited drinks are available for purchase. This welcoming community event provides a supportive environment for performers and a relaxing social atmosphere for all attendees. For more information contact Rick at (408) 930-7372.
